question: What practice concerning the soul is being declared as having been told to the one addressed as Bhairavī?
premises: This is indicated as the subject.
The practice of the soul is named.
It is stated to have been told to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of the practice is not specified by these tokens.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
